items.title: Ray Bauduc and Nappy Lamare Interview, 1959-09-09
items.q: we got the new sizzle cymbal that we worked out with Mr. Bedeus Zildjian

ctx.x: Well, we got the new sizzle cymbal that we worked out with Mr. Bedeus Zildjian. It came about during the time of the Chinese war, the Chinese war with Japan.
Oh yeah, you couldn't get there.
